manuscript_role: Supplementary evidence for R2-M1 and R2-m5; truth resource for related R2-M3
audience: Genome Biology editor and spatial-transcriptomics reviewers
one_sentence_takeaway: Optional coordinate-conditioned effects create recoverable within-cell-type spatial truth, while optional capture, ambient, and dropout controls behave as declared and leave the original output unchanged when disabled.

panels.A: Phenotype labels, direct spatial log-fold truth, and observed Gene 95 expression after combined artifacts
panels.B: Configured versus recovered coefficients for linear, radial, hotspot, and structure-distance effects across 20 seeds
panels.C: One-factor calibration for capture, ambient background, and dropout
panels.D: Consequences for library size, zero fraction, mean-variance association, and latent recovery

panel_c_layout: Equal-sized two-over-one calibration grid: capture and ambient above, dropout centered below.
simulation_scale: 50 x 50 nominal lattice, approximately 1,600 retained cells per seed, 500 genes
effect_design: For each spatial basis, 96 nonzero-effect genes span coefficients from -1 to 1 and 24 null-control genes provide the zero level; gene results are summarized within seed before across-seed display.
representative_gene: Gene 95: the seed-0 strength-1 linear gene with the largest minimum phenotype-specific baseline mean; selected without using realized observed counts.

visual_conventions.latent_truth: diverging blue-red spatial map and open black diamonds

assumptions_and_limits: The analysis validates declared simulator behavior rather than fit to a real platform.
Coordinate-conditioned effects apply only to the native reference-free generator.
The R2-M3 multi-method SVG benchmark is separate even though it can reuse gene_truth.tsv.
